impact_scope.description: S1 introduces the public PNG decoder.decode_frame callable. H0 is a JSON-only harness and has no entry or call path for this new PNG decoding surface.

evidence: S0 has no matching declaration in the selected source file.
Because decoder.decode_frame did not exist in S0, its own exposure gap is false under the identity rule.
S1 introduces pub func decoder.decode_frame?(dst, src, blend, workbuf, opts).
H0 enables only BASE and JSON modules, constructs only wuffs_json__decoder, and calls only JSON decode_tokens paths.
H0 has no PNG decoder entry, decode_frame call, caller-supplied pixel buffer/work buffer/options, or required PNG decoder call-sequence exercise.

new_harness_obligation.description: To expose the introduced decoder.decode_frame surface, H0 would need a PNG-capable entry/call path and must supply its required arguments and lifecycle state; none of those caller actions were necessary in S0.
evidence: The new callable requires dst, src, blend, workbuf, and opts arguments.
decode_frame can implicitly invoke decode_frame_config and advances call_sequence to end-of-data, creating a PNG decoder lifecycle path for a harness invoking this API.
The existing JSON harness cannot reach this callable through its decode_tokens calls.

reason: The principal comparison unit is the mechanically anchored public decoder.decode_frame declaration, not the broader PNG module or related image-decoder methods. It is absent in S0, so Gap(S0,H0) is false. It exists in S1 but unchanged H0 has no route to invoke or control it, so Gap(S1,H0) is true. The false-to-true transition is NEW, which triggers maintenance.
